fixes.explanation: It's True, friend, and I get why you hesitated. The question put peaceful up front, so pleasant can sneak right past you. But the verse says, "All her ways are pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful." (Proverbs 3:17) Both are in there, and ALL shows up twice, like a batch where every single cookie comes out right. Even I can't promise that one.
